title: Four-loop gauge and three-loop Yukawa beta-functions in a general renormalizable theory
claim: All tensor-structure coefficients of the general 4-loop gauge (202) and 3-loop Yukawa (308) beta functions, fixed by direct computations in four toy models (M1-M4, eqs. (4)-(7)) plus WCC; two gauge unknowns fixed using the conjectured symmetry of T_IJ; the gamma5-sensitive 4-loop gauge terms follow from WCC relations to unambiguous 3-loop Yukawa terms, confirming the prescription advocated in Bednyakov-Pikelner 2016 (R = 3); model M4 (U(1) with chiral Dirac fermions) confirms delta = 0 for a Yukawa combination.
scheme: MS-bar; gamma5 prescription inherited from 2016 work; RGBeta, DIANA, FORCER
symmetry_argument: WCC (Poole-Thomsen relation, holds for any 4-loop gauge beta in a general QFT) + symmetric T_IJ conjecture

proved: full set of coefficients (Table 1: unknowns 202 -> 0, 308 -> 0); SM 4-loop gauge and 3-loop Yukawa reproduced; THDM checks
assumed: symmetry of T_IJ (used to fix two coefficients; 8 remaining constraints as checks)
WCC validity for the gamma5 sector; Hermitian anomalous-dimension choice

red_flags: the gamma5-odd sector again fixed via WCC, not by a consistent regularization
cross_checks: full agreement with S5.21_DaviesHerrenThomsen2022 (which does not use T_IJ symmetry)
